President John Dramani Mahama has called on churches to protect vulnerable people and serve their communities.

Speaking at the World Assemblies of God Congress in Accra, the President urged leaders to mentor young people and support schools.

The gathering brings over 10,000 delegates to Accra for the first African-hosted congress.
